text:
maya: heads up — during the q4b longctx quant smoke I noticed a spike in hallucination regressions vs baseline on the golden set. sharing quick numbers and asking for curation + labeling bandwidth.

jon: ugh. can you paste the failing examples? rough delta? :eyes:

maya: overall EM down 6.3% on our golden 1k, hallucination tag up 4.8%. attaching a tiny sample: 
```json
[{"id":"g-1123","prompt":"Summarize the article below...","baseline":"fact-based summary","quant4b":"made-up details about CEO"}]
```

li: thanks. is this isolated to longctx sequences or seen on shortctx too?

maya: shortctx is fine. failing examples are >2k tokens. seems like kv-cache or attention change after quantization.

sara: we should mark these for golden relabel + add a targeted sampling pass. i can allocate 2 labelers tomorrow morning if we scope. what tag set do you want?

maya: target tags: hallucination, hallucination_type (fabrication/incorrect-infer), context-miss. also a note field for likely trigger (truncation, prompt template, model).

jon: propose we do a two-stage: 1) quick triage by eng to weed infra/segfaults, 2) labeler relabel on curated bucket. i'll run a QC script to classify obvious template-induced failures.

maya: cool. Jon — i pushed a sampling query to the samplebank: `samplebank query --match longctx --model q4b --score-delta > /tmp/longctx-fails.json`

ops-bot: deploy-bot reported: quant4b-canary v1 -> v2 rolled back automatically at 2023-10-12T14:05Z due to 5% degradation on route "generation-longctx".

li: rollbacks help but we need root cause. can we get kv-cache traces for a few IDs? maybe sequence alignment changed.

jon: yes — i'll capture kv-cache diffs with `kv-diff --ids g-1123,g-1189 --base baseline --new quant4b` and upload.

sara: labeling plan: i will create a micro-golden of 200 examples prioritized by EM delta and hallucination signal. labelers assigned: alice + rachel. i'll create tasks with explicit instruction examples.

maya: thanks. also can we add an eval route comparing logits at each position for baseline vs quant? might expose where probability mass shifts.

li: good idea. adding a soft-rescore diff check. example command: `python compare_logits.py --ids g-1123,g-1189 --models baseline,quant4b --out /tmp/logit-diffs`

jon: timeline: eng triage in next 4h, label task created EOD, micro-golden relabel results by tomorrow noon. if relabel confirms false positives, we can do targeted kernel revert or fine-tune quant params.

maya: prioritization note: customers using long-form summarization route are seeing elevated errors in canary. tagging @support to surface to CS if needed.

sara: created task: https://labelflow/tasks/3842 — includes instruction + three positive/negative examples. please review.

maya: reviewed. small wording tweak in the hallucination examples (make fabrication vs inference clearer). updated.

deploy-bot: perf-checker: quant4b v2 latency unchanged, mem slightly lower. regression only in quality metrics.

li: once we get relabel results, let's run an ablation: disable prefix caching vs enable to see effect. might be interaction with cache and quant revs.

jon: noted. i'll earmark a node to reproduce with caching off.

maya: thanks team. i'll follow up with a short report when we have labeled micro-golden and kv-diffs.

sara: thanks — i'll ping when labelers finish. :thumbsup:
